memorial.name: the man in his 30s, with a limp
Dwayne
memorial.epitaph: Oh no. Oh no no. The wild — 66 days of me, and if you're reading this, it's yours now! The notes are good, I promise, keep going!

memorial.name: Vanessa
memorial.epitaph: Contest. 11d. Journal's yours now. The notes hold.

memorial.name: Quinn
memorial.epitaph: If someone's reading this in my handwriting — I didn't make it back. The wild. 6 days I held it. The notes are good. Keep writing.

memorial.name: Kayden
memorial.epitaph: If someone's reading this in my handwriting — I didn't make it back. The wild. 4 days I held it. The notes are good. Keep writing.

memorial.name: Jude
memorial.epitaph: Should this be my final entry: The wild. 8 days of stewardship. The record passes to my successor. Maintain it.

memorial.name: Naran
memorial.epitaph: Well. The wild. 8 days. Statistically, someone had to go first. The journal's yours — try to die less dramatically than me.

memorial.name: Tashi
